```yaml
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

name: Docs Preview Deploy

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs PR Preview"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: deploy-preview
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: >
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.repository == 'NVIDIA/NemoClaw'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Download preview artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr-preview
          path: pr-preview
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}

      - name: Deploy preview
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: pr-preview
          target-folder: pr-preview/${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
          clean: false
          commit-message: "Deploy preview for PR #${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}"

  cleanup:
    if: >
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.repository == 'NVIDIA/NemoClaw'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Remove preview on PR close
        if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: /dev/null
          target-folder: pr-preview/${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}
          clean: true
          commit-message: "Remove preview for closed PR #${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}"
```
